product.body_html:
Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Madecassoside Sticker

Intense Hydration and Soothing Care

Experience the powerful soothing and anti-inflammatory benefits of the Abib Gummy Sheet Mask Madecassoside Sticker. Infused with Madecassoside, a potent derivative of Centella Asiatica, this mask supports collagen production, promoting flexible and firm skin. The addition of Allantoin aids in skin regeneration, while Arginine delivers anti-wrinkle effects for a unified, radiant complexion.

Key Benefits:

  • Soothing and Healing: Madecassoside and Centella Asiatica reduce inflammation and redness, effectively healing scars and acne.
  • Skin Renewal: Allantoin stimulates new skin cell formation, soothing irritation and protecting against external stressors.
  • Anti-Wrinkle Effects: Arginine minimizes fine lines and wrinkles, restoring hydration and preventing moisture loss.
  • Deep Hydration: The highly moisturizing ingredients penetrate deep into the skin, ensuring lasting hydration and a protective moisture barrier.
  • Advanced Microfiber Technology: Ensures 100% essence penetration and adapts to every face shape, providing a snug fit and prolonged moisture.

How to Use:

  1. Apply to cleansed and toned skin.
  2. Leave on for 15 minutes.
  3. Remove the mask and continue with your skincare routine.
